# Hub v2 V1: the tree, the Work area, narrow cards, plain words

Step 1 of 7 of Hub v2. Design page (for the owner; a run cannot open it): https://claude.ai/artifact/WE7wrggvmreJCQxEo6ttRZ. Read PROJECT-BRIEF.md first. Grep context.md for "Mikkadr Hub P5" and read only what you need. No model call anywhere in this step's code. Hub files only: nothing in `dist/` changes.

## Goal
One tree replaces the numbered menu rows. Chat, Work and Assets are the areas; Commit, Tools and Tokens are small rows at the foot (Commit and Tools are placeholders until V2 and V3). Work is one tree that replaces the separate Waiting, Plans and Runs pages. Every page speaks plain words and leaves the bottom-right of the window free.

## Build
1. `hub/work.js` (pure, tested): `buildWork({plans, runs, waiting, found})` returns projects, each with steps. A plan title of the form "Project CODE: title" (CODE = a letter and digits, for example "Scene editor E4: ...", "Hub v2 V1: ...") gives project and step; an optional line `Project: <name>` in the plan text wins; anything else goes under "Other". Each step has ONE status from this list, each with a one-line meaning: Waiting for your approval, Approved (press Start), Working, Has a question for you, Finished (read the result), Done, Stopped (with the reason), Cannot start yet (the plan has no Run block). `nextStep(node)` returns one plain sentence saying what to press and what it costs (model, allowance from `CAPS`). `needsYou(tree)` returns the count. Existing waiting items that are not plans or runs (asset attention, token warnings, found plan files, and later scene edits) appear as items under the project they belong to, or under "Other".
2. `hub/web/shell.js`: replace `ROWS` with a tree description: areas `chat`, `work`, `assets`; foot rows `commit`, `tools`, `tokens`. No numbers. Old hashes keep working: `#waiting` and `#plans` and `#runs` open Work; `#plans/<id>` and `#runs/<id>` open that step inside Work. Keep `titleOf` with the needs-you count.
3. `hub/web/`: a Work page drawing the tree (project, steps, status glyph, "needs you" rows highlighted, a count beside Work), and for the selected step: status with its meaning, the "Next step" line, the existing buttons (Approve, Deny with a note, Start, Resume, Continue with more, Close, answer a question), the plan reader, the run's feed and result. Reuse the existing pure rules in `run-actions.js` and the existing routes; do not weaken any gate (second yes for Opus and Fable, 423 while a run works, hub token).
4. Layout rule in `hub/web/hub.css`: on a window 1100 px or wider, page content is at most 560 px wide and the tree is always visible (about 236 px); the space to the right and a 250 px band at the bottom right stay empty (V6 uses them). Below 1100 px the tree folds behind the existing Menu tab and content may use the width. Recent runs, Result, the reader and the chat list all obey the same maximum; long file names wrap. Keep the look of the current shell (highlight pill, glass, flowing background, accent from the weekly gauge).
5. Plain words in `hub/web/run-actions.js` `feedRow` and `STATUS_LABEL`, and in `hub/activity.js` lines: "Tokens used so far: 41,200 of 1,500,000" (not "turn total"); "Usage check: 36% of this week, 51% of these 5 hours" (not "gauges / fresh reading"); "Started on Sonnet with 6 tools"; "Began working"; "Carried on after your answer"; "Reading dist/world.js", "Editing ...", "Running npm test"; "Used 80% of this run's token allowance"; "Stopped: it used its whole allowance"; "Stopped to protect your weekly limit"; "Press again to confirm (expensive model)"; "Approved. Press Start." Still names and counts only: never the model's own words in a feed.
6. The top of every page shows the two gauges as "This week" and "These 5 hours".
7. Tests: `tests/hub-work.mjs` (grouping, statuses, next-step sentences, count, old hashes) and updates to the existing hub tests for the renamed labels. Update `scripts/hub-shots.mjs` so its screenshots still run; add one of Work at 1400 px and one at 800 px.

## Rules
- Do not change `dist/`, `town.js`, `world.js` or `map-definition.js`.
- No BOM. Run `npm test` after each change; finish with `npm run index`, then `npm test`. Stop with tests passing; report failures honestly and list what was not seen in a real browser.
- Do not edit generated files (PROJECT-BRIEF.md, PROJECT-INDEX.md) by hand. Do not commit.

## Done when
The hub opens on a tree with Chat, Work and Assets; every old Waiting, Plans and Runs action is reachable inside Work with the same gates; no card is wider than 560 px on a wide window; the feed reads in plain words; tests pass.
